name: IZUKU-MD
description: WhatsApp multi-device bot. Clean, fast, quiet by default.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: Your WhatsApp number with country code, digits only. Becomes the bot owner.

SESSION_ID.description: Session id from the pairing site (IZUKU-XXXXXXXXXXXX, single use). Leave empty to use pairing code instead.

PAIRING_NUMBER.description: Bot account number for pairing-code login (digits only). Leave empty if SESSION_ID is set.

SUDO.description: Extra sudo numbers, comma separated, digits only.

OWNER_NAME.description: Owner display name shown in menus.

WORKTYPE.description: public = replies to everyone, private = owner only.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Log verbosity: info, warn or error.

AUTO_STATUS_VIEW_DELAY.description: Delay before viewing a status, milliseconds.

AUTO_STATUS_REACT.description: Optional emoji to react to statuses with.

ANTI_CALL.description: Block WhatsApp calls to the bot (true/false).

ANTI_DELETE.description: Deleted message recovery: off, same (resend where it was deleted) or jid.

ANTILINK_VALUES.description: Link patterns blocked by antilink, comma separated.

ANTI_BAD_WORD.description: Bad words to filter, comma separated. Empty = off.

FAKE_COUNTRY_CODE.description: Country codes rejected on group join, e.g. 92,234. Empty = off.

WELCOME_MESSAGE.description: Custom welcome text. Supports @user and #@count. Empty = built-in.

GOODBYE_MESSAGE.description: Custom goodbye text. Supports @user. Empty = built-in.

REPO_URL.description: Repo link shown in the menu.

CONTACT_EMAIL.description: Optional contact email shown in the menu.
